dedupe_keys.name: tusaga aktif national continuously operating gnss network of turkiye

description: TUSAGA-Aktif is the national network of permanent GNSS stations of Türkiye, completed in 2009, which gives real-time geographic positions with centimetre accuracy within seconds anywhere in Türkiye and the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus where enough satellites are visible and communication is available. Users create an account on the web portal and can start the same day; the portal offers purchase of RINEX data at 1-second and 30-second rates and of RTK or DGPS products, with a user guide, frequently asked questions and a user agreement. The page reports 17 years of operation and about 28,000 active accounts. Access is by registration and purchase of the products; the terms are in the user agreement and no open licence is stated. Caveats: the portal is in Turkish, and data is sold, not openly published. Coverage is Türkiye and Northern Cyprus. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, crustal deformation monitoring for earthquake hazard, and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ASG-EUPOS of Poland and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
name: TUSAGA-Aktif national continuously operating GNSS network of Türkiye
